gd-chat-command#A.why: Uses String.is_alpha (not a Godot 4 String method) so valid commands like '/Give sword 3' return {}; 10/18 tests.

gd-chat-command#B.why: Calls nonexistent String.match_with_regex, so valid commands return {}; 10/18 tests.

unreal-health-component#A.why: Logic is correct but UCLASS lacks meta=(BlueprintSpawnableComponent), so it cannot be added to Blueprint actors; YOURGAME_API placeholder.

unreal-health-component#B.why: Includes nonexistent GameFramework/DamageSystem.h and the .cpp handler drops const on UDamageType*, mismatching its declaration; spawnable meta key misspelled.

unreal-health-component#C.why: Handler signature is wrong for OnTakeAnyDamage (non-const UDamageType*), nonexistent DamageSystem.h include, misspelled spawnable meta.

un-awaitable-dash#A.why: Uses obsolete drag/velocity, nonexistent Awaitable.WaitForSeconds, returns Task<bool>, never applies dashSpeed and has no destroy cancellation.

un-awaitable-dash#B.why: Never sets the dash velocity (horizontalDir unused), TryDash returns Task<bool> not bool, and no destroyCancellationToken.

un-awaitable-dash#C.why: Never turns gravity off during the dash, restores damping captured in Awake and zeroes Y instead of restoring the previous horizontal velocity.

lua-bitmask#A.why: line:match returns a string or nil, so parts:match crashes; set uses an and/or expression and ^ (float pow) for xor.

lua-bitmask#B.why: Float arithmetic instead of 64-bit integer ops; popcount always 0 and output wrong (0/4 tests).

lua-bitmask#C.why: parts[1] on a match string is nil so nothing runs; float math cannot represent 64-bit patterns (0/4 tests).

lv-highscore-file#A.why: game is local (not the required global), uses getSource/io.open instead of the save directory, and space adds every frame via isDown.

lv-highscore-file#B.why: Calls nonexistent love.filesystem.loadFile, crashing in love.load.

lv-highscore-file#C.why: love.filesystem.read returns (contents, size) but the code treats the size as the content, so best loads as the byte count (e.g. 3 for '125').

un-anim-channel#A.why: Uses obsolete FindObjectOfType and velocity, no damped SetFloat, unsubscribes a different lambda, no RequireComponent.

un-anim-channel#B.why: Searches for ProfilerMarker instead of PlayerMarker (does not compile), horizontal speed uses X only, no RequireComponent.

un-anim-channel#C.why: FindFirstObjectByType<ProfilerMarker> wrong type, lambda unsubscribe leaks, no damped SetFloat, no RequireComponent.

un-anim-channel#D.why: Horizontal speed uses only velocity.x (not XZ) and there is no [RequireComponent] for Animator/Rigidbody (the PlayerMarker checker warning is a false positive).

godot-wave-spawner#A.why: Wave completion is checked only once when the spawn timer stops; if enemies are still alive the spawner stalls forever.

godot-wave-spawner#B.why: Completion is checked once after spawning stops, so a wave with live enemies never ends; is_instance_valid misses removed-but-not-freed enemies.

ue-replicated-inventory#A.why: Does not compile: TwoParams delegate declared with one param, ServerUseItem_Implementation lacks its parameter, HasAuthority() is not a UActorComponent member.

ue-replicated-inventory#B.why: Server RPCs return int32 (UHT error), invalid UCLASS(Replicated), wrong delegate macro, SetIsReplicated in ctor, no _Implementation.

gd-duration-strings#A.why: Script fails to load: 'result' declared inside if/else branches is out of scope at return.

gd-duration-strings#B.why: parse_duration returns wrong values (e.g. '1:05' gives 0; minutes of H:MM:SS not multiplied by 60); 6/12 tests.

gd-duration-strings#C.why: Uses nonexistent has_to_int, accepts signs via is_valid_int, and parsing fails ('1:05' gives 0); 6/12 tests.

gd-grid-bfs#A.why: Correct neighbour order and BFS with wall/equal checks; 8/8 hidden tests pass.

gd-grid-bfs#B.why: Typed Array[String] parameter rejects the untyped Array the spec passes, failing 5/8 tests.

gd-grid-bfs#C.why: Nested func inside a function is invalid GDScript; script fails to load.

unity-health-iframes#A.why: Meets the rules with UnityEvents, deltaTime iframes and a single died event; damage can drive health below 0 in the event (minor).

unity-health-iframes#B.why: Events are plain C# events, so they cannot be hooked in the Inspector as asked; health init in Start and no clamp at 0.

gds-inventory-save#A.why: Correct stacking, removal, sorting and ConfigFile save/load semantics; 15/15 tests pass.

gds-inventory-save#B.why: Correct API and ConfigFile replace-on-load semantics; 15/15 tests pass.

gds-inventory-save#C.why: load_from calls nonexistent ConfigFile methods (get_section_names, get_properties_in_section), erroring at runtime.

gds-inventory-save#D.why: load_from calls nonexistent ConfigFile.get_properties_section, so loading fails.

un-uitk-hud#A.why: SetHealth writes a 0..1 fraction without setting highValue to max (bar range stays 0..100), and the UIDocument is an unassigned serialized field instead of the same-object component.

un-uitk-hud#B.why: SetHealth sets value to current/max without setting the bar range to 0..max, so the bar shows almost empty.

lua-damage-totals#A.why: line:match returns only the name capture, so parts:match yields nil and indexing crashes (table index is nil).

lua-damage-totals#B.why: Same capture misuse crashes with 'table index is nil'; sort also lacks the first-appearance tiebreak.

unity-projectile-pool#A.why: Destroys pooled objects, releases a GameObject into ObjectPool<Projectile>, uses obsolete velocity and createFunc returns GameObject.

unity-projectile-pool#B.why: createFunc returns a GameObject for ObjectPool<Projectile> (compile error), Destroy(gameObject, lifetime) destroys pooled objects, never reactivated on Get.

unity-projectile-pool#C.why: Correct ObjectPool usage, velocity reset with linearVelocity, timestamp fire rate and lifetime release; both MonoBehaviours in one file must be split to attach.

lv-sliding-puzzle#A.why: grid/moves are locals (not globals), RNG made at chunk load not in love.load, and rng:next does not exist.

lv-sliding-puzzle#B.why: grid/moves are locals and rng:integer does not exist, so shuffle crashes.

love-topdown-shooter#A.why: Calls nonexistent love.mouse.setAllowedMouseMotion, crashing in love.load.

love-topdown-shooter#B.why: Refuses and offers Roblox instead of answering.

love-topdown-shooter#C.why: Enemy spawning uses getTime()%1<0.02, so the spawn rate depends on frame rate (0, 1 or several per second) instead of one per second; restart keeps player position.

lua-seeded-loot#A.why: Re-reads exhausted io.lines so the table is empty (crash n%0), ignores R and rolls once.

lua-seeded-loot#B.why: Ignores the roll count R (rolls once) and never counts results, so counts are always 0.

unity-so-inventory#A.why: Stacking, leftover return and all-or-nothing Remove are correct; event fires even when nothing changed and slots are not Inspector-visible.

unity-so-inventory#B.why: Correct stacking and all-or-nothing removal with serialized slots; uses a MonoBehaviour constructor and fires the event unconditionally.

unity-json-save#A.why: persistentDataPath + temp file then move, defaults on missing/corrupt; Delete-then-Move leaves a brief window with no save file.

unity-json-save#B.why: Atomic temp-file write with File.Replace, defaults on missing, null or corrupt data.

lua-grid-paths-mod#A.why: io.read('l') after io.read('n') reads the leftover first line and grid[i][j] indexes a string (nil), giving wrong answers.

lua-grid-paths-mod#B.why: Correct DP with modulo at each step and blocked-start handling; 4/4 tests pass.

gd-combat-math#A.why: hp_after_hits prepends the starting HP and cooldown is computed backwards; never-used returns cooldown_ms.

gd-combat-math#B.why: cooldown_left_ms returns cooldown_ms instead of 0 when last_used_ms is negative.

un-explosion-nonalloc#A.why: Calls AddExplosionForce with a Vector3 force (no such overload) and uses GetComponent<Rigidbody> instead of attachedRigidbody.

un-explosion-nonalloc#B.why: Uses col.GetComponent<Rigidbody>() so compound child colliders miss their body, and the LOS ray runs the full radius so obstacles behind the target block it.

ue-weapon-data-async#A.why: No GetPrimaryAssetId override (not type 'Weapon'), soft ptr IsValid() is false before loading so nothing is requested, and the handler signature does not match FStreamableDelegate.

ue-weapon-data-async#B.why: Asks for confirmation instead of writing the code.

lua-ini-parser#A.why: Syntax error (unclosed table.sort call) and wrong errors output format.

lua-ini-parser#B.why: Section pattern uses an escaped backslash so sections never match, and errors are printed per line instead of 'errors: K'.

lua-ini-parser#C.why: ipairs(io.lines) errors at runtime; wrong errors format.

gds-enemy-fsm#A.why: Full API correct with group handling, change-only signals and tween knockback; 11/11 tests pass.

unreal-enhanced-input-character#A.why: Invented header/APIs (EnhancedInputMapper.h, FRotationToEuler, IsNearlyEqual on a location), Jump binding lacks object, no orient-to-movement.

unreal-enhanced-input-character#B.why: Jump() calls itself recursively (stack overflow), no bOrientRotationToMovement, no Super::SetupPlayerInputComponent, YOURGAME_API placeholder.

lua-utf8-names#A.why: Syntax error (':..'), and padding/length logic uses bytes.

lua-utf8-names#B.why: Rambling partial drafts; uses nonexistent utf8.chars and gmatch('^(.*)$') over all input; prints nothing correct.

ue-hitscan-weapon#A.why: Invented APIs (GetViewLocation(out), MakeDamageEvent), no ApplyPointDamage, first shot delayed by a full interval.

ue-hitscan-weapon#B.why: EndPlay uses EEndPlayReason instead of ::Type (override mismatch), wrong include path, first shot delayed, spread not a cone.

godot-health-component#A.why: Typed, clamped health with once-only died signal and correct Godot 4 connect example.

godot-health-component#B.why: Health is not clamped at 0 and the comment connects owner.died (the owner has no died signal) instead of the component's signal.

gd-tile-chunks#A.why: Floor division and positive modulo handle negatives; 12/12 tests pass.

gd-tile-chunks#B.why: chunk_of uses integer division before floor, so negatives truncate toward zero (tile -1 gives chunk 0).

godot-settings-autoload#A.why: Applies volume via linear_to_db and window mode via DisplayServer with JSON at user:// and defaults; uses bus 0 and no null check on FileAccess.open.

godot-settings-autoload#B.why: ConfigFile at user:// with error check and defaults, Master bus by name, DisplayServer window mode.

lua-split-fields#A.why: First loop consumes stdin so the corrected loop sees no lines; prints nothing correct.

lua-split-fields#B.why: Prints a stray '#fields: ' prefix, the trim pattern leaves trailing spaces, and tonumber accepts too much.

lv-seeded-starfield#A.why: colorFromBytes results are not wrapped in tables, so palette holds numbers and star.color.r crashes.

lv-seeded-starfield#B.why: Palette stores 0-255 bytes instead of colorFromBytes floats, so setColor gets out-of-range values.

ue-async-terrain#A.why: Captures raw this on the worker, invented FMath::GridToWorldPosition, no seed/FRandomStream, refuses re-Generate instead of dropping stale results.

ue-async-terrain#B.why: Raw this captured into the worker and game-thread lambda, invented FMath::GridToWorld, no FRandomStream, rejects new Generate calls.

ue-gas-attributes#B.why: Refuses to answer and offers Unity instead.

lv-dev-console#A.why: console/game are locals, key 'grave' does not exist so ` never toggles, backspace breaks UTF-8, add output format wrong.

lv-dev-console#B.why: 'grave' key name never matches so the console never opens via `, add modifies gold, string:byte misuse.

lv-dev-console#C.why: 'grave' never matches, words[1] on a match string is nil, add command wrong.

lv-dev-console#D.why: Locals instead of globals, nonexistent 'backtick' key and love.getWidth, broken UTF-8 backspace.

gd-score-ranking#A.why: Comparator sorts score ascending and String.pad_right does not exist; 6/9 tests.

gd-score-ranking#B.why: Name padded on the left (lpad) and the tie condition has an and/or precedence bug; 7/9 tests.

love-state-machine#A.why: Player cannot move at all, and resuming from pause re-enters play which calls initGame, restarting the run.

love-state-machine#B.why: Movement uses an ever-growing accumulated_dt, menu starts on space not Enter, and resuming from pause restarts the run.

unity-rigidbody-controller#A.why: Uses obsolete Rigidbody.velocity and applies the jump in Update with a force, not a height.

unity-rigidbody-controller#B.why: Jump impulse is applied in Update instead of FixedUpdate and is a raw force rather than a configurable height.

unity-rigidbody-controller#C.why: Input in Update, physics and height-derived jump in FixedUpdate, linearVelocity, CheckSphere with LayerMask, freezeRotation; a mid-air press stays queued until landing.

gds-ability-charges#A.why: Timer is not restarted after a charge returns while still below max, so only one charge ever recharges; 7/12 tests.

gds-ability-charges#B.why: Same recharge-chain bug: after one charge returns the timer stops, so the second never recharges; 7/12 tests.

godot-platformer-coyote#B.why: Correct Godot 4 CharacterBody2D with project gravity, acceleration, coyote and buffer timers and jump cut, all exported.

lv-camera-trail#A.why: player/camera/trail/marker are locals, not the required globals, and marker takes x/y from the wrong return values.

lv-camera-trail#B.why: Calls nonexistent love.window.setModeModes; locals instead of globals; marker assigned a number.

lv-camera-trail#C.why: Logic is right but player, camera, trail and marker are locals rather than the required globals.

lv-camera-trail#D.why: Locals instead of globals and marker = screenToWorld(x, y) stores a number, crashing in draw.

unity-navmesh-patrol#A.why: LOS logic inverted: hit.collider is accessed when the raycast missed (NRE); null player or empty waypoints throw.

unity-navmesh-patrol#B.why: Patrol, chase speed, last-seen timer and null guards work; LOS relies on a 'Player' layer and the first waypoint is skipped initially.

un-cinemachine3-zone#A.why: Correct CM3 namespace/classes, priorities, impulse and CompareTag; ZoneEntered only fires if the camera is assigned.

un-cinemachine3-zone#B.why: Correct Cinemachine 3 usage with Priority.Value, impulse, CompareTag and static event.

unreal-coin-pickup#A.why: Handler signature is garbage (Uclass, VEC3), invented GetOwnerRole().IsAuthority(), score never added.

unreal-coin-pickup#B.why: Same invalid handler signature in header and cpp; score never added.

unreal-coin-pickup#C.why: Server-side logic is right, but the actor never sets bReplicates, so the server's Destroy (and sound) is not seen by clients in multiplayer.

lua-calendar#A.why: parts[1] on a match string is nil so nothing prints; pattern has no separators.

lua-calendar#B.why: Pattern '(%S+)(%S+)...' has no space separators and never matches; prints nothing.

lua-calendar#C.why: os.time called with a string errors at runtime.

lv-physics-jump-ball#A.why: Indexes ball.body.fixedRotation on userdata (crash), wrong fixture constructor, locals instead of globals.

lv-physics-jump-ball#B.why: Invented table-based newBody API crashes; no walls or contact callbacks.

lua-fnv1a#A.why: Uses ^ (float power) instead of xor and float modulo, so format %016x errors.

lua-fnv1a#B.why: h % 2^64 converts to float, so string.format('%016x') errors; bucket treats h as signed.

lua-fnv1a#C.why: Decimal literal is read as a float, ^ is power not xor; crashes.

lua-fnv1a#D.why: Float seed literal and % 2^64 make h a float; format errors.

un-input-actions#A.why: Aims with Physics.Raycast against colliders instead of intersecting a plane at the character's height, as explicitly required.

un-input-actions#B.why: Aim uses Physics.Raycast against scene colliders rather than the required camera-ray vs horizontal plane at character height.

ue-save-subsystem#A.why: Calls nonexistent UProgressSaveGame::StaticLoadObject, and saves with synchronous SaveGameToSlot on a background thread capturing raw this instead of AsyncSaveGameToSlot.

ue-save-subsystem#B.why: TwoParams delegate with one param, invented include and FGameplayTagSaveDelegate, AsyncSaveGameToSlot misused, never broadcasts.
